decision.article_title: JBL、AIでボーカルやギターを分離。演奏が一緒に楽しめる「BandBox Solo/Trio」一般販売 - AV Watch
decision.reason: JBL BandBox Solo/Trio uses embedded AI sound separation during music play; replicating the core audio inference/product requires hardware or an AI runtime, excluded by model-free no-extra-cost Radar scope.
